verse.name: v1
v2
verse.lines:
Nze ndi munafu ddala.
Amaanyi gampweddemu;
So sirina magezi,
Ekkubo limbuze.
Beera-Omusaale wange,
Mu masamganzira,
Bw'onkwata n'omukono
Ndituuka-emirembe.

verse.name: v3
verse.lines:
Siyinza n'akatono,
Kutambula nzekka;
Ggwe-oli Mubeezi wange
Mu biro-eby'ennaku:
Ggwe tonjabuliranga,
Nneme-okubungeeta,
Siritya kabi konna,
Mu ntuuko-ez'okufa
